title: UNVERIFIED — The Town at Lunch

features.name: a public clock with an irregular shudder
features.desc-on-touch: As though each second has to be individually persuaded.

features.name: the drinking fountain
features.desc-on-touch: She holds the front of her dress against her chest, closes her eyes, and takes a sip from the parabola.

features.name: a bookstore, next to the Choo Chew Take Away
features.desc-on-touch: Local histories in the window, and a book of poetry by a publican. She does not replace the book lost to the bathwater. She takes a different one, bound in green cloth, faded along the spine to the colour of a boiled pea.

features.name: the door
features.desc-on-touch: She finishes the paragraph as she reaches it. Once inside, she moves beyond what is knowable. The render stops at the step.

inscription: every store is both open and closed, in a state of empty rest

file.name: GreenCloth_title_unrecorded.txt
file.note: Thick paper, pleasant to turn. One paragraph read on the way down the street.

exits.label: back along the road she drove
the next hotel
exits.to: NEW: a hotel whose publican wrote a book of poetry, where she might stay tomorrow, depending on events
